correspondence.contract: Read lhs slot0 then rhs slot1; one Add16 request/result per logical beat; output slot2; inputs released only after sealed output; shared port arbitrated and loan drained. Source reference computes current+previous; finite FP32 sum value matches lhs+rhs; no universal NaN-payload equivalence.

Only drain returns credit DDR bytes; final ACK must retire before Dense terminal and lease invalidation. Model synthetic ready/response stalls differ from actual iDMA latency. Physical output must be completely ACKed before public publication.

V8/ILP4/3 blocks: 16 terms,3 blocks,4 residues,8 lanes; FP32 mean+epsilon1e-6+sqrt+reciprocal; direct gamma; BF16 after scale and gamma. Square/vector final products permit finite UF; ordinary scalar Add/Div/Sqrt reject inexact UF, accept NX.

Bias FP32 raw+bias then BF16; split-half RoPE with BF16 table/products/sums and nonfused Add/Mul. Vector raw flags unreported; finite UF/NX accepted; nonfinite final stores rejected. No full invalid-domain error-timing equivalence claimed.
